- **Ownership:** 100% Brand-Owned Custom Domain & Isolated Database — One-Time Setup, **0% Monthly Sales Commission Forever**
- **6 Conversion-Tested Industry Themes:**
  1. Organic Food & Agro Brand (`?preset=food`)
  2. Fashion, Panjabi & Clothing Label (`?preset=fashion`)
  3. Skincare & Beauty Studio (`?preset=cosmetics`)
  4. IT, Tech & Smart Gadgets Store (`?preset=tech`)
  5. Super Shop & 60-Min Daily Mart (`?preset=supershop`)
  6. Home & Kitchen Appliances (`?preset=electronics`)
- **8 Core Platform Capabilities:**
  1. No-Code Visual Brand Studio (12+ Blocks, Mobile Preview, 1-Click Safe Rollback)
  2. 15-Second Bangladeshi Guest Cash-on-Delivery (COD) Checkout & 11-Digit Phone Validation
  3. Unlimited Nested Category Tree, Mega Menus & Automatic 308 SEO Redirects
  4. Flash-Sale Armor: PostgreSQL 17 Atomic Stock Locking & Idempotency Duplicate-Order Guard

  6. Enterprise Security: 4 Staff RBAC Roles, Owner 2FA (MFA), Argon2id & AES-256-GCM Encrypted API Vault
